cat_rows: EPIC Physical activity questionnaire - derived variables [52111]

This category contains derived data from the EPAQ2, which assessed self-report physical activity in four domains (leisure time, occupation, transportation and domestic life). Estimates of PA energy expenditure (PAEE) sedentary behaviour, light (LPA) and moderate-to-vigorous PA (MVPA) were obtained from EPAQ2. Questions were asked in 2006-10 (age 60-64 years)
